content: notify-debouncer-full 0.7.0 coalesces duplicate and related filesystem events and documents callback or channel handling; it exposes watch/unwatch and Debouncer is a drop guard. Keep it alive inside the serialized vault I/O worker, drain WatchMsg there, and invoke Store::classify/rescan; do not perform scan/index work in the UI callback. docs.rs notify-debouncer-full.
